title: Career Roadmap: PhD Candidate
summary: Develop advanced expertise in a scientific discipline by conducting original research, investigating unanswered questions, publishing findings and contributing new knowledge under the guidance of a doctoral supervisor.

facts.Current degree: BS (Research) – Physics / Chemistry / Mathematics / Biology / Materials Science

blocks.text: Develop advanced expertise in a scientific discipline by conducting original research, investigating unanswered questions, publishing findings and contributing new knowledge under the guidance of a doctoral supervisor.

rows.text: Science stream with subjects relevant to the intended research discipline
BS (Research), B.Sc. (Research) or another eligible bachelor's degree
Research internships, final-year thesis, scientific writing and subject-specific methods
Apply to eligible PhD programmes in India or abroad, meeting each institution's requirements
Complete coursework, qualifying requirements where applicable, original research, thesis and defence

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: A BS (Research) does not automatically guarantee PhD admission. Eligibility depends on the institution, subject, academic performance, entrance requirements and applicable funding rules.

blocks.label: Research Thinking
blocks.text: Formulate research questions, hypotheses and testable objectives.

blocks.label: Subject Expertise
blocks.text: Strong foundations in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology or Materials Science.

blocks.label: Research Methods
blocks.text: Experimental design, theoretical modelling, computational methods or laboratory techniques.

blocks.label: Data Analysis
blocks.text: Statistics, scientific computing, Python or R, and discipline-specific software.

blocks.label: Academic Communication
blocks.text: Literature reviews, research papers, presentations and scientific citation.

blocks.label: Research Ethics
blocks.text: Reproducibility, data integrity, responsible conduct and collaboration.
Build evidence of research readiness through:

items.text: A substantial undergraduate research project or thesis.
A critical literature review identifying an unanswered research question.
A supervised laboratory, theoretical or computational project.
A research poster, seminar presentation or conference contribution.
A documented analysis report with methods, findings and limitations.

blocks.text: A publication can be beneficial, but it is not a universal prerequisite for PhD admission.
Explore opportunities at:

items.text: IISERs, NISER and IITs.
Indian Institute of Science (IISc).
CSIR laboratories and other national research institutions.
University research groups and specialist laboratories.
International university research programmes, where eligible.
Industrial R&D laboratories in relevant scientific fields.

blocks.text: Contact potential supervisors with a concise CV, academic interests and evidence of relevant project experience.
Depending on the institution and discipline, investigate:

blocks.label: CSIR-UGC NET
blocks.text: Relevant science subjects and applicable eligibility categories.

blocks.label: GATE
blocks.text: Accepted by certain institutions and programmes.

items.text: Institutional PhD entrance tests and interviews.

blocks.label: International admissions
blocks.text: University-specific applications, research proposals and English-language requirements where applicable.

blocks.label: Research methods
blocks.text: Statistics, scientific writing, computational tools and discipline-specific laboratory training.
Funding and eligibility rules change, so check the latest official admission notifications and fellowship guidelines.

Scientist / Faculty Member / R&D Specialist

A PhD candidate is already enrolled in doctoral study. The usual pathway is undergraduate research preparation followed by admission to a PhD programme; a postdoctoral position is one possible next step after completing the PhD.

rows.text: Select a research area, review recent papers and identify potential supervisors.
Complete or strengthen a research project, learn relevant tools and prepare a concise academic CV.
Check PhD eligibility and funding, prepare application materials and contact suitable research groups.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Strong disciplinary knowledge, research experience, analytical skills, academic writing ability and a clear research direction aligned with eligible doctoral programmes.
